name: sort
expr: [sa, ia] = sort(v); [sd, id] = sort(v, 'descend'); m = sort([3 5; 1 2; 8 4], 1, 'descend');
comment: Sig [s,i]=sort(X[,dim][,direction]): default ASCEND with NaN LAST: sort([3 1 NaN 2])=[1 2 3 NaN], idx=[2 4 1 3]. 'descend' with NaN FIRST: [NaN 3 2 1], idx(1)=3. Matrix sort(M,1,'descend') sorts each column descending: col1 [8 3 1], col2 [5 4 2]. numkit previously IGNORED the 'descend' direction (always ascended) and left NaN unsorted in place -- fixed (direction + dim parsing in sort_reg, NaN-aware stable comparator).
